Local SEO for roofers

Win the storm calls across every neighbourhood, not just your own street — one map pin can't show where the demand actually finds you.

Win the storm calls across every neighbourhood

When weather moves through, “roofer near me” and “storm damage” spike across whole neighbourhoods at once — and they all go to whoever ranks first on the map. A roofer has no storefront, and a single map pin can’t show which of those neighbourhoods can actually find you, so the backlog goes to a rival. Eagle Eye scans your entire service area on a grid of up to 441 points and shows, block by block, where you win the calls and where you don’t.

See the whole service area, not one pin

  • One pin hides the area — you can rank first at the yard and vanish in the suburbs the storm hit. A grid shows both.
  • LSOV — the share of the whole service area that finds you in the top 3.
  • Seasonal scheduled scans — run the grid through storm season and see demand shift before the backlog does.
  • A competitor map per rival — the roofers owning the neighbourhoods you’re invisible in.

Start free: 10 scans, a free first scan of your own company up to 21 × 21, and credits that never expire — ready when the next storm hits. Roofing is a service-area business — see the plans.

Three numbers, every scan

Three numbers a client remembers and a trend that proves your work paid off. Every scan rolls the whole grid into them — no spreadsheet, no hand-waving.

LSOVLocal Share of Voice

How much of the whole grid finds the business near the top — one number for the entire map.

ARPAverage Rank, found

The mean position across only the points that return the business at all.

ATRPAverage Total Rank

The same average, counting every point that missed the business entirely — the honest one.

Questions, answered

How does Eagle Eye help a roofer rank across a service area?

It scans the entire service area on a grid of up to 441 points and shows, block by block, where you win the storm calls and where a rival does — a roofer has no storefront, so a single pin hides the area.

Can I track demand through storm season?

Yes — run the grid on a schedule through the season and see demand shift across neighbourhoods before the backlog does.

Can I see which roofers own the neighbourhoods I’m invisible in?

Eagle Eye draws a competitor map for every rival that outranks you — their rank at every point of the same grid — so you see exactly which competitor wins each block, not just that you place #5.

Why isn’t one map pin enough for a roofer?

You can rank first at the yard and vanish in the suburbs the storm hit. A grid shows both the strong areas and the blank ones.

Is there a free scan to start?

A new organisation starts with 10 free scans, and your first scan of your own website is free at any size up to 21 × 21 — no card needed.

See the blocks you're winning — and the ones you're not

Run a real geo-grid scan on your own business, any size, no card. In minutes you'll see every block you own, every block a rival is taking, and the one number you can hand a client.
